privacy.seoDescription: How PSR Maintenance Services collects, uses, and protects your personal information.

sections.heading: 1. Introduction
paragraphs: PSR Maintenance Services Ltd ("we", "our", or "us") is committed to protecting and respecting your privacy. This Privacy Policy explains how we collect, use, and safeguard your personal information when you visit our website or use our services.

sections.heading: 2. Information We Collect
sections.intro: We may collect and process the following data about you:
list: Personal identification information (name, email address, phone number)
Details about your property and the services you require
Communication records between you and us
Technical data (IP address, browser type, device information)

sections.heading: 3. How We Use Your Information
sections.intro: We use your personal information to:
list: Respond to your enquiries and quote requests
Communicate with you about your project

sections.heading: 4. Data Security
paragraphs: We implement appropriate technical and organisational measures to protect your personal data against unauthorised access, alteration, disclosure, or destruction.

sections.heading: 5. Your Rights
sections.intro: Under UK data protection law, you have the right to:
list: Object to processing of your data

sections.heading: 6. Contact Us
paragraphs: If you have any questions about this Privacy Policy or how we handle your data, please contact us at:

terms.seoTitle: Terms of Service | PSR Maintenance Services
terms.seoDescription: Terms and conditions for using PSR Maintenance Services website and services.

sections.heading: 1. Acceptance of Terms
paragraphs: By accessing and using the PSR Maintenance Services website and services, you agree to be bound by these Terms of Service. If you do not agree to these terms, please do not use our website or services.

sections.heading: 2. Our Services
paragraphs: PSR Maintenance Services provides property maintenance, renovation, and trade services in Greater Manchester, UK. All work is carried out by qualified and insured tradespeople.

sections.heading: 3. Quotes and Estimates
paragraphs: Quotes provided are based on the information supplied by you. Final costs may vary if the scope of work changes or if unforeseen issues are discovered during the project. We will always communicate any changes before proceeding.

sections.heading: 4. Payment Terms
list: A deposit may be required for larger projects
Payment is due on completion of work unless otherwise agreed
We accept bank transfer, credit/debit cards, and cash
Late payments may incur interest charges

sections.heading: 5. Cancellations
paragraphs: We understand that plans can change. Please provide at least 48 hours notice for cancellations or rescheduling. Deposits may be forfeited for cancellations with less than 48 hours notice.

sections.heading: 6. Warranties and Guarantees
paragraphs: All work is guaranteed for a minimum of 12 months from completion. Manufacturer warranties on materials apply where applicable. Gas and electrical work comes with the appropriate certification.

sections.heading: 7. Limitation of Liability
paragraphs: While we maintain comprehensive insurance, our liability is limited to the value of the work performed. We are not liable for indirect or consequential losses.

sections.heading: 8. Governing Law
paragraphs: These Terms of Service are governed by and construed in accordance with the laws of England and Wales. Any disputes shall be subject to the exclusive jurisdiction of the courts of England and Wales.

sections.heading: 9. Changes to Terms
paragraphs: We reserve the right to modify these terms at any time. Changes will be effective immediately upon posting to our website. Your continued use of our services constitutes acceptance of the updated terms.
